snippet.title: Making a SLOTMACHINE controlled ROGUELIKE
snippet.description:
You can play the PEREELOUS demo for FREE on my itch.io : https://pierre-vandermaesen.itch.io/pereelous

Stay in touch while I work on the game by joining our discord : https://discord.gg/Y4ZSwWysFC

This devlog explains how I made a simple roguelike dungeon crawler controlled by slotmachines

Check out @JackieCodes as well, so many cool games where made during the jam!
